name: brandrail
description: Design system guardrails for AI coding tools: tokens, components and a brand checker. Runs locally.
long_description: Brandrail gives your AI coding tool your design system: colour, spacing and type tokens, your component registry, and a checker that flags hard-coded colours, off-scale spacing and raw HTML, with the fix. Runs on your machine; code is never uploaded. Without an API key it uses starter tokens. Add a key from Dashboard > Connect to load your organisation's Brand Kit. Inside a repo, `npx brandrail connect` is the recommended setup.

api_key.title: Brandrail API key (optional)
api_key.description: From Dashboard > Connect. Leave empty to try it with starter tokens.

tools.name: get_guidelines

tools.name: get_design_tokens
tools.description: Every token with the CSS variable to use.

tools.name: find_component
